texto.muro: the calm, deep dark studio space on the left of the frame

escena: SCENE (cinematic, a real long-exposure photograph of one night of campaign production inside a vast dark studio): behind her, a GIANT wall runs from the RIGHT edge of the frame, where its nearest and largest pieces are cut by the frame edge, and recedes in deep perspective toward a vanishing point hidden behind her body; no part of the wall is visible to the left of her left shoulder. It holds about FIFTY pieces of ONE campaign for a fictitious brand: vertical stories, square posts, wide banners, email headers, product cards and one billboard, every one in the SAME visual system (deep navy, white and cool blue, the same photograph of one fictitious sneaker, the same diagonal composition), no letters, no numbers, no logos. During the exposure, the last pieces flew in from the deep dark background on the right, never from the left half of the frame and locked into place: they are long cool white-azure (#0375DB) motion streaks that end exactly in their slot of the grid, while the pieces already placed are perfectly aligned in one grid: the nearest ones, at the right edge, are crisp, and along the wall they fall progressively out of focus until the far end melts into bokeh behind her. Karo, as in her reference, the art director, stands perfectly still and SHARP with she stands entirely in the right half of the frame: from the left edge to the middle of the frame there is only empty dark studio, with nothing lit in it, framed from the waist up, wearing the Efeonce hoodie exactly as in its reference, holding the tablet in both hands at stomach height, below the chest mark, with its SCREEN TURNED TOWARD THE CAMERA, showing us the master piece like an art director showing a proof; we see the screen, never the back of the tablet; both arms fully visible; her head stays almost frontal and her eyes turn toward the empty dark left of the frame, where the text will sit, with a confident, slightly sideways half-smile; between the left edge of the frame and her body there is a wide band of empty darkness. On the master piece, ONE single tiny point glows vivid orange (#FF6500), the only accent in the frame; it lights nothing around it. The glowing wall of pieces beside her is the key light on her face, cool white, from the camera-right at face height; NO fill light, the far side of her face in shadow with the nose shadow legible. The wall never enters the left half of the frame. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two and a half meters away at chest height, 85mm. Thin haze catches the streaks. The LEFT 60 % of the frame is calm, deep dark studio space with only faint haze: no objects, no light shapes, no streaks, no pieces; everything lit lives in the right 40 %. Rich contrast, deep navy blacks, real sensor grain, genuine depth of field. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos of any other brand.
